ar: ليه الزر ده مش ظاهر عندي؟
en: What can staff do versus the owner?
Why can I not see a button?

steps: Owner: everything for the store incl. money, settings, campaigns, team
Staff (needs a seat): inbox, notes, pause/cancel campaigns, read bot settings and funnel
Super admin: Ebda employees only (operator console)
edgeCases: Staff without a seat sees the NoSeat page
gaps: No single help article listing role permissions (only guide 14 on seats)
